# Analysis scope

This notebook imports MATLAB decoding, RSA, and encoding exports; computes the
reported time-series cluster tests; and assembles EEG panels for main Figures
4--6 and SI Figures S2--S4. Chunk labels and export file names refer to the
current figure numbering; exports are loaded by file name (`read_export`).

```{r Import data, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
## Import MATLAB exports
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(R.matlab, ggpubr, dplyr, tidyr, reshape2, viridis, permuco, ggh4x) 


if(.Platform$OS.type == "unix") {
data_dir <- ("/Users/davidegheza/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Personal/Documenti/MATLAB/dg_workspace22/dimensions/analyses/scripts_and_settings/reported/export_to_R/")
} else {
data_dir <- ("C:/Users/gdavide/OneDrive/Documenti/MATLAB/dg_workspace22/dimensions/analyses/scripts_and_settings/reported/export_to_R/") 
}


times = seq(-800, 1498, by = 10)

read_and_extract_data <- function(file) {
    data=readMat(file)
    subfield_name = names(data)[1] # Assuming there is always only one subfield
    data = data[[subfield_name]]
    data = data[, , 1]
    return(data)
}

# Load a MATLAB export from data_dir by file name (without .mat)
read_export <- function(name) read_and_extract_data(file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, ".mat")))

# Shared plot settings.
fontsize <- 14
fontsize2 <- 16
Labels = c('Color', 'Shape', 'Edge', 'Pattern')
PC_names_full = c('Neu1', 'MI', 'MC', 'Neu2')
PC_names = c('NeuAVG', 'MI', 'MC')



### Cluster-permutation support

# Interleave observed time series with their null value for `permuco` tests
# following the Maris-Oostenveld cluster-mass framework.
dat_matrix = function(ts,zero_level) { # specify timeseries (sbj by time) and chance level
  ts = data.frame(ts)
  colnames(ts) = times
  zeros_matrix = data.frame(matrix(zero_level, nrow = nrow(ts), ncol = ncol(ts)))
  colnames(zeros_matrix) = colnames(ts) 
  ts = ts %>%     # interleave observations and null-value rows
          mutate(row_number = row_number(),
          var = 1) %>%
          bind_rows(zeros_matrix %>%
          mutate(row_number = row_number(),
                 var = 2)) %>%
          arrange(row_number, var) %>%
    mutate(
      row_number = NULL,
      var = NULL
    ) %>% data.matrix()
  return(ts)
}
```

```{r Fig_4, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# Final Figure 4B-D: decoding accuracy and model-1 RSA

# Figure 4B: multiclass decoding accuracy.
class_acc_list = read_export("Fig4_classification_accuracy")
names = names(class_acc_list)
# Convert the 4D array to a long dataframe
lda_acc = class_acc_list[["group.lda.cond.acc"]] # [[ ]] to extract array from a list
num_conditions <- dim(lda_acc)[3]
condition_names <- c("Left Color", "Left Shape", "Left Edge", "Left Pattern", "Right Color", "Right Shape", "Right Edge", "Right Pattern")

plot_data <- data.frame()
for (co in 1:num_conditions) {
  temp_data <- data.frame(
    time = times,
    accuracy = apply(lda_acc[,,co,], 3, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    condition = condition_names[co]
  )
  plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, temp_data)
}
plot_data$side <- ifelse(grepl("^Left", plot_data$condition), "Left", "Right")
plot_data$condition <- factor(plot_data$condition, levels = condition_names)
plot_data$dimension <- factor(gsub( ".* ", "", plot_data$condition ), levels = c("Color", "Shape", "Edge", "Pattern"))


# Plot
x1 = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time, y = accuracy, color = dimension, linetype = side)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = T, name = "Dimension") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Left" = 1, "Right" = 0.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 12.5, linetype = "dotted") + # Reference line at 12.5%
  geom_vline(xintercept = -200, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = c(10, 25)) +
  annotate("text", x = -200, y = 7.5, label = "Cue\nonset", size = 5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = range(times), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = 'Time (ms)', y = 'Accuracy (%)', color = 'Dimension', linetype = 'Side') +
  ggtitle('Group-average LDA accuracy') +
  theme_minimal(base_size = fontsize) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  ) 
x1
ggsave(plot = x1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300, filename = "f4_LDA_accuracy.pdf")

# Figure 4D: dimension-resolved RSA estimates and RT distributions.
rsa_m1_bydim_list = read_export("Fig4_m1_RSA_betas_bydim_bst0")
names = names(rsa_m1_bydim_list)
# function to process each model (SR, RU, SI)
process_array_4d <- function(data_list, array_name, labels, model_names) {    # 4d array: sbjs, pc, time, task/distractor
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(3, 4), mean) # over the 1st and 2nd dimensions (sbj and PC)
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(3, 4), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  colnames(mean_values) <- labels
  colnames(sem_values) <- labels
  mean_df <- as.data.frame(mean_values)
  sem_df <- as.data.frame(sem_values)
  mean_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_df$times = times
  sem_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_long <- mean_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "value")
  sem_long <- sem_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "sem")
  result_long <- mean_long %>%    # Combine mean and SEM into a single data frame
    left_join(sem_long, by = c("Dimension","t"))
  result_long$Dimension <- factor(result_long$Dimension, levels = Labels)
  result_long$model <- substr(array_name, 6, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = model_names)
  
  return(result_long)
}
# apply function
model_names = c(substr(names[1], 6, nchar(names[1])),
                substr(names[2], 6, nchar(names[2])), 
                substr(names[3], 6, nchar(names[3])))
df_sr <- process_array_4d(rsa_m1_bydim_list, names[1], Labels, model_names)
df_ru <- process_array_4d(rsa_m1_bydim_list, names[2], Labels, model_names)
df_si <- process_array_4d(rsa_m1_bydim_list, names[3], Labels, model_names)
df_allmodels <- rbind(df_sr,df_ru,df_si) 

# plot, each model to one subplot, and 4th subplot for RT distribution
ylims <- c(-0.1, 0.8)
dat_text <- data.frame(
  model   = model_names,
  label    = c("Cue\nonset", "", ""),
  x     = c(-200, 0, 0),
  y     = c(-0.35, 0, 0)
)
x3 = df_allmodels %>%

  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T, name = "Dimension") +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = T, name = "Dimension") +

  geom_vline(xintercept = -200, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = ylims) +
  # annotate("text", x = -200, y = -0.25, label = "Cue\nonset", size = 5) +
```

```{r notreported_m2, echo=FALSE, results="hide", eval=FALSE}
# non-cued rule by single-distractor and cued dimension
rsa_m2_bydim_list = read_export("notreported_m2_RSA_betas_bydim")
names = names(rsa_m2_bydim_list)
# function to process each model (just ru_dist here) when including each distractor and each cued task
process_array_5d <- function(data_list, array_name, labels, model_names) {    # 5d array: sbjs, pc, time, distractor, task
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(3, 4, 5), mean) # over the 1st and 2nd dimensions (sbj and PC)
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(3, 4, 5), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  df1 <- as.data.frame.table(mean_values, responseName="value")
  df2 <- as.data.frame.table(sem_values, responseName="sem")
  df <- left_join(df1,df2, by = c("Var1","Var2","Var3"))
  names(df) <- c("times", "distractor", "task", "value", "sem")
  df$times = times
  df$distractor = factor(df$distractor, labels = Labels)
  df$task = factor(df$task, labels=Labels)
  df$model <- substr(array_name, 6, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = model_names)
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r Fig_5, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# Final Figure 5B-C: model-3 cued and distractor representations

# Figure 5B: cued and average distractor conjunction representations.
rsa_m3_list = read_export("Fig5_Fig6_m3_RSA_betas")
names = names(rsa_m3_list)
# function to process each model (SR, SR distractors average)
process_array_3d <- function(data_list, array_name) {
    array <- data_list[[array_name]]
    mean_values <- apply(array, c(3), mean) # over the 1st and 2nd dimensions (sbj and PC) - i.e., apply over times, to keep
    sem_values <- apply(array, c(3), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
    df <- data.frame(
        times = times,
        value = mean_values,
        sem = sem_values,
        model = substr(array_name, 6, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = c("sr", "sr.dstr")) # levels specification is just to set order
    )
  
  
  df <- data.frame(
            times = times,
            value = mean_values,
            sem = sem_values,
            model = substr(array_name, 6, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = c("sr", "sr.dstr")) # levels specification is just to set order
          )
  
  return(df)
}
# apply function
df_sr <- process_array_3d(rsa_m3_list, names[1])
df_sr_dstr <- process_array_3d(rsa_m3_list, names[2])

df_allmodels_m3 <- rbind(df_sr,df_sr_dstr) 


# compute cluster-based permutation analysis 
# (Maris & Oostenveld, 2007 - package from Frossard: github.com/jaromilfrossard/permuco)
p_x = 0.05 # critical p threshold for cluster selection
# First define function to prepare data matrix
dat_matrix = function(ts,zero_level) { # specify timeseries (sbj by time) and chance level
  ts = data.frame(ts)
  colnames(ts) = times
  zeros_matrix = data.frame(matrix(zero_level, nrow = nrow(ts), ncol = ncol(ts)))
  colnames(zeros_matrix) = colnames(ts) 
  ts = ts %>%     # interleave observations and null-value rows
          mutate(row_number = row_number(),
          var = 1) %>%
          bind_rows(zeros_matrix %>%
          mutate(row_number = row_number(),
                 var = 2)) %>%
          arrange(row_number, var) %>%
    mutate(
      row_number = NULL,
      var = NULL
    ) %>% data.matrix()
  return(ts)
}
# prepare data matrix (sbj by times) for permuco
zero_level = 0 # zero for testing betas, chance level for testing classification, etc
sr = apply(rsa_m3_list$fits.sr, c(1, 3), mean) # average over PC (preserve dim sbjs)
sr = dat_matrix(sr,zero_level)
sr_dstr = apply(rsa_m3_list$fits.sr.dstr, c(1, 3), mean) 
sr_dstr = dat_matrix(sr_dstr,zero_level)

# prepare design for permuco (data frame for the independent variables)
design_m3 = data.frame(sub_id = rep(1:26,2), var = c(rep(1,26),c(rep(0,26)) )) %>% arrange(sub_id, desc(var))
# run cluster mass permutation test
sr_cmt = clusterlm(sr ~ var,              # cluster mass test for sr 
                   data = design_m3,
                   np = 5000,
                   test = "fisher",
                   p_scale = TRUE,
                   threshold = 0.95) # Cluster-forming threshold
plot(sr_cmt)
sr_sum = summary(sr_cmt, 'two.sided')
sr_cluster = c(sr_sum$var[[1]],sr_sum$var[[2]])

sr_dstr_cmt = clusterlm(sr_dstr ~ var,
                   data = design_m3,
                   np = 5000,
                   test = "fisher",
                   p_scale = TRUE,
                   threshold = 0.95) # Cluster-forming threshold
plot(sr_dstr_cmt)
sr_dstr_sum = summary(sr_dstr_cmt, 'two.sided')
sr_dstr_sum = data.frame(sr_dstr_sum$var)
sr_dstr_cluster = sr_dstr_sum[ (sr_dstr_sum$P..mass. < p_x),]


# Plot
significant_clusters <- data.frame(
  start = c(times[sr_cluster[1]], times[sr_dstr_cluster$start]), 
  end = c(times[sr_cluster[2]], times[sr_dstr_cluster$end]), 
  offsets = c(-0.06, -0.04),
  model = c("sr", "sr.dstr")
)
colors <- c(
  rgb(0, 0, 0, maxColorValue = 255), # black
  rgb(0, 112, 192, maxColorValue = 255) # blue
  )
ylims <- c(-0.05, 0.60)
x7 = df_allmodels_m3 %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = times, ymin = value-sem, ymax = value+sem, fill = model), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = times, y = value, color = model, linetype = model), size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -200, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = ylims) +
  annotate("text", x = -200, y = -0.25, label = "Cue\nonset", size = 5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = range(times), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = 'Time (ms)', y = 'RSA beta') +
  theme_minimal(base_size = fontsize) +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'northwest',
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )
x7 = x7 + # adding significant cluster bars
  geom_segment(data = significant_clusters, aes(x = start, xend = end, 
                                                y = offsets, yend = offsets, color = model), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) 
x7 
ggsave(plot = x7, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, filename = "f5_m3_RSA_conjunction_cued_noncued.pdf")


# Figure 5C: representations resolved by cued or distractor dimension.
```

```{r Fig_5_SFig2_SFig3_CSE, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# prepare design for permuco (data frame for the independent variables)
design_CSE = data.frame(sub_id = rep(1:26,2), var = c(rep(1,26),c(rep(0,26)) )) %>% arrange(sub_id, desc(var))

# function to process CSE data (from matlab - 3-dimensional). E.g., param data: previous sum con: 4   times: 230    sbj: 26
process_array_cse_param <- function(data_list, array_name, labels, model_names) {   
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  array <- aperm(array, c(3,2,1)) # transpose: 26  230  4
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(2,3), mean) # over the 1st and 2nd dimensions - i.e., apply over times and prev_sum_con, to keep
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(2,3), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  colnames(mean_values) <- labels
  colnames(sem_values) <- labels
  mean_df <- as.data.frame(mean_values)
  sem_df <- as.data.frame(sem_values)
  mean_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_df$times <- times
  sem_df$t <- seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_long <- mean_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "line_var", values_to = "value")
  sem_long <- sem_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "line_var", values_to = "sem")
  result_long <- mean_long %>%    # Combine mean and SEM into a single data frame
    left_join(sem_long, by = c("line_var","t"))
  result_long$line_var <- factor(result_long$line_var, levels = labels)
  result_long$model <- substr(array_name, 4, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = model_names)
  
  return(result_long)
}

# function to process single-condition CSE data (from matlab - 4-dimensional). (prev cng, on/off, time, sbj: 2 2 230 26)
process_array_cse_single <- function(data_list, array_name, labels_1, labels_2, model_names) {   
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  array <- aperm(array, c(4,3,1,2))                               # transpose: 26  230  2 (prev cng) 2 (on/off)
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(2,3,4), mean) # over the 1st and 2nd dimensions - i.e., apply over times and prev_sum_con, to keep
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(2,3,4), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  df1 <- as.data.frame.table(mean_values, responseName="value")
  df2 <- as.data.frame.table(sem_values, responseName="sem")
  df <- left_join(df1,df2, by = c("Var1","Var2","Var3"))
  names(df) <- c("times", "prev_cng", "line_var", "value", "sem")
  df$times = times
  df$prev_cng = factor(df$prev_cng, labels = labels_1)
  df$line_var = factor(df$line_var, labels=labels_2)
  df$model <- substr(array_name, 1, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = model_names)
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r SFig3_basic_SFig4_resplocked, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# function to process datasets from Matlab (cued / distractor) # 3d: 26 230 4 sbjs, time, task (projection). 4d array: 26 230 4 dist (projection) 4 task
process_array_3_4d <- function(data_list, array_name, labels, model_names) {    
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(2, 3), mean, # if 4d, over the 1st and 4th dimensions (sbj and cued task); if 3d, over the 1st dimensions (sbj) only
                       na.rm = T) # for distractor projections, 1 task/distractor combination is always nan
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(2, 3), sd,
                       na.rm = T) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  colnames(mean_values) <- labels
  colnames(sem_values) <- labels
  mean_df <- as.data.frame(mean_values)
  sem_df <- as.data.frame(sem_values)
  mean_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_df$times = times
  sem_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_long <- mean_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "value")
  sem_long <- sem_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(labels), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "sem")
  result_long <- mean_long %>%    # Combine mean and SEM into a single data frame
    left_join(sem_long, by = c("Dimension","t"))
  result_long$Dimension <- factor(result_long$Dimension, levels = Labels)
  result_long$model <- substr(array_name, 1, 4) %>% factor(levels = model_names)
  
  return(result_long)
}
```

```{r Fig_6A, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# Final Figure 6A: proportion-congruency effects on cued and distractor RSA
PC_names = c('MI', 'Neu', 'MC')
rsa_m3_list = read_export("Fig5_Fig6_m3_RSA_betas")
names = names(rsa_m3_list)
# new function to process each model (SR, SR distractors average) by PC - include averaging the two Neutral PCs
process_array_3d_byPC <- function(data_list, array_name, model_names) {
  array <- data_list[[array_name]]
  # average the Neu PCs
  neu_avg <- (array[, 1, ] + array[, 4, ]) / 2
  new_array <- array(0, dim = c(dim(array)[1], 3, dim(array)[3])) # new array with 3 PCs 
  new_array[, 1, ] <- array[, 2, ] # MI
  new_array[, 2, ] <- neu_avg      # Neu
  new_array[, 3, ] <- array[, 3, ] # MC
  array = new_array
  # proceed as usual
  mean_values <- apply(array, c(2,3), mean) # over the 1st dimension (sbj) - i.e., apply over PC and times, to keep
  sem_values <- apply(array, c(2,3), sd) / sqrt(dim(array)[1])
  mean_values <- t(mean_values) # PC over columns
  sem_values <- t(sem_values)
  colnames(mean_values) <- PC_names
  colnames(sem_values) <- PC_names
  mean_df <- as.data.frame(mean_values)
  sem_df <- as.data.frame(sem_values)
  mean_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_df$times = times
  sem_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_long <- mean_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(PC_names), names_to = "PC", values_to = "value")
  sem_long <- sem_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(PC_names), names_to = "PC", values_to = "sem")
  result_long <- mean_long %>%    # Combine mean and SEM into a single data frame
    left_join(sem_long, by = c("PC","t"))
  result_long$PC <- factor(result_long$PC, levels = PC_names)
  result_long$model <- substr(array_name, 6, nchar(array_name)) %>% factor(levels = model_names)

  
  return(result_long)
}
```

```{r Fig_6B-E, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
# custom colors

rsa_m3_list = read_export("Fig6_m3_RSA_betas_bydim") # obtained with bootstrapping (bst=1)

# function to process each distractor dimension by PC - include averaging the two Neutral PCs. Process one distractor a time. Input: filtered sr.singledstr, using 1 distractor only.
process_array_4d_filtered_to_3d_byPC <- function(array_3d, distractor_dim_name) {
  # average the Neu PCs
  neu_avg <- (array_3d[, 1, ] + array_3d[, 4, ]) / 2
  MC_MI = (array_3d[, 3, ] - array_3d[, 2, ])
  new_array <- array(0, dim = c(dim(array_3d)[1], 4, dim(array_3d)[3])) # new array with 3 PCs + 1 contrast
  new_array[, 1, ] <- array_3d[, 2, ] # MI
  new_array[, 2, ] <- neu_avg      # Neu
  new_array[, 3, ] <- array_3d[, 3, ] # MC
  new_array[, 4, ] <- MC_MI        # MC-MI
  narray = new_array
  # proceed as usual
  mean_values <- apply(narray, c(2,3), mean) # over the 1st dimension (sbj) - dims:  26sbj 4pc 230times
  sem_values <- apply(narray, c(2,3), sd) / sqrt(dim(narray)[1])
  mean_values <- t(mean_values) # PC over columns
  sem_values <- t(sem_values)
  colnames(mean_values) <- PC_names
  colnames(sem_values) <- PC_names
  mean_df <- as.data.frame(mean_values)
  sem_df <- as.data.frame(sem_values)
  mean_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_df$times = times
  sem_df$t = seq.int(nrow(mean_df))
  mean_long <- mean_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(PC_names), names_to = "PC", values_to = "value")
  sem_long <- sem_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(PC_names), names_to = "PC", values_to = "sem")
  result_long <- mean_long %>%    # Combine mean and SEM into a single data frame
    left_join(sem_long, by = c("PC","t"))
  result_long$PC <- factor(result_long$PC, levels = PC_names)
  result_long$dimension <- distractor_dim_name %>% as.factor()
  result_long$contrast = ifelse(result_long$PC=="MC-MI", 'contrast', 'simple')
  result_long$contrast = factor(result_long$contrast, levels=c('simple','contrast'))
                         

  return(result_long)
}
# take rsa_m3_list$fits.sr.singledstr (dims:  26sbj 4pc 230times 4distractors), filter one distractor dimension, apply function
m3_array <- rsa_m3_list$fits.sr.singledstr
alldistr_byPC_list = vector("list", length = 4) # preallocate w/ distractor
for (distIDX in 1:4){
  singledstr_filt = m3_array[,,,distIDX]
  df_singledstr_byPC = process_array_4d_filtered_to_3d_byPC(singledstr_filt, paste0("dist_",Labels[distIDX]))
  alldistr_byPC_list[[distIDX]] = df_singledstr_byPC
}

# long-format w/ PC, time, distractor
df_alldistr_byPC = do.call(rbind, alldistr_byPC_list)


# plot, PC simple and MC-MI contrast in different subplots
ylims <- c(-0.12, 0.22)
dat_text <- data.frame(
  contrast   = unique(df_alldistr_byPC$contrast),
  label    = c("", "\n\n\nCue\nonset"),
  x     = c(0, -200),
  y     = c(0, -0.13)
)
for (idx in 1:4){
  all_colors = c(viridis_colors, dim_colors[idx])
  x10 = df_alldistr_byPC %>% filter(dimension==paste0("dist_",Labels[idx])) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(x = times, ymin = value-sem, ymax = value+sem, fill = PC), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(x = times, y = value, color = PC), size = 1) + #  linetype = model
    scale_fill_manual(name = "PC", values = all_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "PC", values = all_colors) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -200, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = ylims) + # 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = range(times), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = 'Time (ms)', y = 'RSA beta') +
    theme_minimal(base_size = fontsize) +
    facet_grid(contrast ~ ., scales="fixed") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c('solid','dashed'),guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
    data    = dat_text,
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = label)
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(), 
      strip.text = element_blank(), 
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.80, 0.45)
    )
  x10
  




  # add cluster stat bars to non-cued and non-cued MC-MI subplots
  # prepare data matrix (sbj by times) for permuco. Design is same as before (subid, var=data vs 0)
  offset = c(-0.095, -0.110, -0.125, -0.10)
  zero_level = 0 # zero for testing betas, chance level for testing classification, etc
  singledstr = rsa_m3_list$fits.sr.singledstr # 26sbj 4pc 230times 4distractors) (compared to data for plot, here we do not average over sbj)
  sdstr_filt = singledstr[,,,idx]      # keep one distractor dim
    neu_avg = (sdstr_filt[, 1, ] + sdstr_filt[, 4, ]) / 2
    MC_MI = (sdstr_filt[, 3, ] - sdstr_filt[, 2, ])
    new_array = array(0, dim = c(dim(sdstr_filt)[1], 4, dim(sdstr_filt)[3])) # new array with 3 PCs + 1 contrast
    new_array[, 1, ] = sdstr_filt[, 2, ] # MI
    new_array[, 2, ] = neu_avg      # Neu
    new_array[, 3, ] = sdstr_filt[, 3, ] # MC
    new_array[, 4, ] = MC_MI        # MC-MI
  sd_pc = aperm(new_array, c(1, 3, 2))
  sd_pc_cluster = data.frame()
  p_x = 0.05 # critical p threshold for cluster selection
  # run cluster mass permutation test for Neu, MI, MC (skip contrast)
  for (PCidx in 1:4){
    dstr_mx = dat_matrix(sd_pc[,,PCidx],zero_level)
    pc_cmt = clusterlm(dstr_mx ~ var,              # cluster mass test
                       data = design_m3,
                       np = 5000,
                       test = "t",
                       p_scale = TRUE,
                       threshold = 0.95) # Cluster-forming threshold
    plot(pc_cmt)
    PC_sum = summary(pc_cmt, alternative = "greater")
    PC_sum = data.frame(PC_sum$var)
    sig_clusters = PC_sum[ (PC_sum$P..mass. < p_x),]
    if (length(sig_clusters$cluster.mass)>0){
      sig_clusters$PC = PC_names[PCidx]
      sig_clusters$offset = offset[PCidx]
      sig_clusters$contrast = ifelse(PCidx==4,'contrast','simple') %>% as.factor() # to add error bar selectively to facets
      sd_pc_cluster = rbind(sd_pc_cluster, sig_clusters)
    }
  }

  
  if(!dim(sd_pc_cluster)[1]<1){ # adding significant cluster bars, if any
    x10 = x10 + 
      geom_segment(data = sd_pc_cluster, aes(x =  times[start], xend = times[end], 
                                                    y = offset, yend = offset, 
                                                    color = PC), size = 3)
  }
  
  ggsave(plot = x10, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, filename = paste0("f6_m3_RSA_conjunction_noncued_byPC_distr", Labels[idx], ".pdf"))


  x10
}
```
